description: The default reporter's text under Jest 30.5.2 (T9.7, B21c): a file's PASS and FAIL header (`./` before a root-level path, no timing), no line for a skipped file, a console block under its own bullet (the message lines; the `at` line and the blank lines around it are left out), the summary and the exit code. One file each passes, fails, skips and has a todo, logs to the console, and fails a stored snapshot. One Jest worker, `--ci`, the default reporter. A black-box run; the kept lines are the ones `provino jest` is held to (`provino`'s `reporters.test.ts`).
